title.narrative: Comprehensive Protection Solutions: Emergency Shelter and Non-Food Items for Flood-Affected Forcibly Displaced Persons in the Far North Region of Cameroon

description.narrative: Thanks to the CERF Rapid Response allocation, UNHCR will be able to have additional funds to cater to the immediate suffering of flood-affected populations by ensuring access to life-saving assistance and protection. This includes providing emergency shelter, restoring basic services, and reducing the vulnerability of displaced persons to further risks. The response aims to stabilize the living conditions of affected households while paving the way for more comprehensive recovery and rehabilitation efforts.This intervention aligns with the strategic priorities outlined in the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework for Cameroon 2022-2026, the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) 1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 10, 11, 13, 15, 16, and 17, the Cameroon National Development Strategy 2030, and the strategic objectives of the 2022-2026 UNHCR Cameroon Multi-Year Strategy. The following activities will be conducted: - Provision of emergency shelter and non-food items (NFIs) benefiting 13,000 internally displaced persons (IDPs), returnees, and host communities in two divisions of the Far North Region. UNHCR and partners will support cash and in-kind provision of emergency shelters (wooden structures and plastic sheets) and NFIs to all affected populations. The NFI kit compositions includes mats, blankets, mosquito nets, kitchen kits, jerrycans, buckets, and basins.
